The `chError.h` header file is included in multiple CUDA source files, suggesting it is part of the `chLib` library. We need to ensure that this header is correctly included and that the necessary library is linked during compilation.

I will update the `CMakeLists.txt` file to include the path to the `chLib` directory and link against the `chLib` library.

Here's the updated `CMakeLists.txt`:

```cmake
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(texturing)

set(CMAKE_CUDA_STANDARD 14)

# Add the chLib directory to the include path
include_directories(chLib)

# Link against chLib
target_link_libraries(tex1dfetch PRIVATE chLib)

add_executable(tex1dfetch tex1dfetch.cu)
```

Now, I will rebuild the project with these changes.
